usual_baseline: Poor adherence to European guidelines: 17% of pathways [2804], 36% [2184], 43.1% [2628]. Scans late: median 556 days to second scan [2372]. 41.6% lost to follow-up in primary care [2628]. Both over- and under-treatment: 58 unnecessary scans and 35 missed cholecystectomy referrals [2804].
fix_that_works: Inviting overdue patients back. A GP practice sent invitations for repeat imaging or a consultation, and 100% returned to surveillance [2628].
fix_that_fails: No failed fix reported in these audits
consultant_advice: Only one audit closed the loop, so a real re-audit would add something. Ultrasound reports are part of the problem: 0% documented sessility and 35% omitted wall thickness [2804]. Auditing radiology reports, or unnecessary cholecystectomy (true polyp in 6% [2590]), is more useful than another adherence count.
